turns.prompt: Fit the nonlinear model y = b1 / (1+exp[b2-b3*x]) to the data in rat42.csv (columns x, y) by least squares, starting from b1 = 100, b2 = 1, b3 = 0.1. Report every parameter (b1, b2, b3) to at least 6 significant digits and the residual sum of squares as rss.

provenance: NIST StRD Rat42 (public domain), data copied verbatim
